# Quiet Money

> The money rules nobody taught you. Short videos on money psychology and personal finance, each written out with its math and sources.

Educational content, not financial advice. Every number is computed; every story is sourced.

## Pages
- [Money Rules Library](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/): every video as a written page
- [Calculators](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/tools/): compound growth, credit card payoff, inflation
- [Free 7-day Money Reset](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/): printable checklist
- [About](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/about/): what Quiet Money is and how videos are made

## Money rules
- [How to Kill Hidden PayPal Billing Authorizations](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/how-to-kill-hidden-paypal-billing-authorizations/): PayPal stores recurring merchant billing agreements indefinitely unless you manually revoke them. Learn the exact 3-step path in your browser settings to cancel active merchant permissions and plug silent money leaks.
- [Why You Irrationally Overvalue Things You Own](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-you-irrationally-overvalue-things-you-own/): Learn how the endowment effect tricks your brain into overvaluing everyday possessions, from unworn clothes to unused cars. By applying the replacement test, you can liquidate idle assets and put that money to work in compounding investments.
- [Why Your Paycheck Carries the Highest Tax](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-paycheck-carries-the-highest-tax/): Earned income faces higher taxes than asset growth. Understanding the Cashflow Quadrant shows why trading time for money keeps you behind, and how systematic investing changes the equation.
- [Why Avoiding Credit Cards Costs You More](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-avoiding-credit-cards-costs-you-more/): Many avoid credit entirely due to fear of debt, missing out on fraud protection, cash flow float, and structural benefits that reward disciplined users.
- [The Front-Loaded Mortgage Shock](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-front-loaded-mortgage-shock/): Analyzing a $400,000 mortgage at 6.5% reveals the brutal reality of front-loaded interest payments over the first five years.
- [The $180 Move That Crushed Wall Street](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-180-move-that-crushed-wall-street/): Grace Groner purchased $180 worth of stock in 1935 and held it for 75 years, reinvesting every dividend. Her quiet patience outperformed professional traders and built a $7 Million fortune. Real wealth comes from letting compounding work without interruption.
- [The Raise Math Nobody Teaches You](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-raise-math-nobody-teaches-you/): Learn the exact mechanics behind payroll tax withholding on bonuses and raises. Understand why net pay drops temporarily and how tax refunds fix the gap.
- [The Decoy Effect: Why You Buy the Most Expensive Option](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-decoy-effect-why-you-buy-the-most-expensive-option/): Learn how the decoy effect manipulates your spending decisions at cafes, restaurants, and online stores. By placing an overpriced middle option, companies trick you into buying the most expensive tier. See how small daily spending traps compound over time and how to avoid them.
- [How a 19-Year-Old Blew £9.7 Million in 8 Years](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/how-a-19-year-old-blew-9-7-million-in-8-years/): At 19, Michael Carroll won nearly £10 million on the lottery, only to end up broke less than a decade later. Sudden wealth acts like an accelerant when capital arrives before financial discipline, social boundaries, and emotional maturity. Learn the golden rule to protect your future.
- [The Rule of 100: How Volume Beats Talent](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-rule-of-100-how-volume-beats-talent/): Breaking out of the paycheck-to-paycheck cycle requires building a valuable skill through sheer repetition.
